rules.good_entry: Daily close above entry_trigger (200-day avg); crypto names also need BTC-USD above its 200-day avg
rules.stage_in: NVDA and SPCX only: may buy small monthly amounts below trigger if analyst upside >= 25%
rules.trim: Up >=30% from cost and analyst upside <10%, or price >40% above 200-day avg
rules.exit: Month-end close below 10-month avg after having been above it, or 25% below cost
